description: The plot titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature” illustrates how Pass@8 accuracy varies with the Temperature setting for three methods. The x-axis is labeled “Temperature,” uses a linear scale, and spans 0.1 to 1.0 with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8),” uses a linear scale, and ranges from about 62.5 to 80.0 with evenly spaced tick marks every 2.5. The On-policy RL series is shown as an orange solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts near 63.5 at temperature 0.1, rises to about 70.0 at 0.2, stays around 69–72 through 0.6 (about 71.8 at 0.5 and ~71.8 at 0.6), dips to about 67.5 at 0.7, peaks around 75.0 at 0.8, drops to about 71.0 at 0.9, and ends near 73.5 at 1.0. The Ours series is a red solid line with star markers; it begins around 76.0 at 0.1, increases to about 78.8 at 0.2, sits near 76.2 from 0.3 to 0.4, rises to about 77.0 at 0.5 and ~77.0 at 0.6, increases to about 79.8 at 0.7 and ~80.6 at 0.8, dips to about 78.8 at 0.9, and ends near 80.6 at 1.0. The SFT series is a teal solid line with downward-pointing triangle markers; it starts around 76.0 at 0.1, declines to about 75.2 at 0.2 and ~74.5 at 0.3–0.4, drops to about 70.0 at 0.5, rises back to about 76.0 at 0.6, falls to about 71.8 at 0.7, increases to about 73.5 at 0.8, dips to about 71.8 at 0.9, and ends near 74.5 at 1.0.
